title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe Martinique
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe network subscribers in Martinique. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: The delays could impact timely message delivery for Backbase clients.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: Removal of the Send to Coworker action from the Domain Authentication setup flow, requiring users to update their workflows.
backbase_rationale: Ensures more secure and reliable DNS record updates by eliminating low-usage, error-prone email-based methods.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: The SDK now requires a minimum Android API level of 24, potentially breaking existing apps targeting lower levels.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update its Android applications to target API level 24 or higher to continue using this SDK.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: Accessibility updates align the SDK with WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA standards, and support eIDAS for selected countries.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should assess whether its use of the SDK meets the new accessibility and eIDAS compliance requirements.
